appearance_facts.fact: Bold black title reads 'Increasing Regional Air Quality Recovery from 2018 to 2023'.
A single solid blue line connects six points, one per year from 2018 to 2023.
The line starts near the top left at 2018, drops to its lowest point at 2019, rises to its highest point at 2020, then steps down and remains nearly flat through 2021, 2022, and 2023.
The 2023 endpoint sits slightly below the 2021 and 2022 levels and is clearly above the 2019 low but below the 2018 and 2020 peaks.
Vertical axis is labeled 'Recovery Score'; horizontal axis is labeled 'Year' with tick labels 2018 through 2023.

public_definitions: Select the follow-up route that best matches the overall dashboard trend for the 2018-2023 planning case.

uncertain: No explicit numeric values are printed at each data point; the 2018 value appears just above the 2,800 tick and the 2020 peak slightly above 2,800, but exact scores are not labeled.

The mapping from 'overall trend' (flat-to-slightly-declining after 2020) to a specific route is interpretive; the chart title says 'Increasing' while the line's later years are flat/declining, creating a mild conflict between title wording and line shape.
